$comment: Configurations for `npm run bench -- --compare` (docs/DEV_TOOLS.md; scripts/configs.ts describes the fields). Each scenario runs once per configuration and is compared with the baseline.

configs.name: outline-silhouette
configs.notes: The mesher with the ink outline's silhouettes (docs/ART_DIRECTION.md §7, shared/look/outline.json): its cost is the composite's.

configs.name: outline-creases
configs.notes: The mesher with the ink outline's silhouettes and creases.

configs.name: outline-blocks
configs.notes: The mesher with the ink outline's silhouettes, creases and block edges.

configs.name: pixelart-180
configs.notes: The pixel-art preview's 180 preset (docs/proposals/PIXEL_ART_LOOK.md, shared/look/pixelart.json): 180 rows, banded light and ambient, the dwell palette, edges.

configs.name: pixelart-270
configs.notes: The pixel-art preview's 270 preset: 270 rows (the spec's 480 × 270), banded sun, the dwell palette, silhouette edges.

configs.name: pixelart-270-warm
configs.notes: The pixel-art preview's 270-warm preset: as 270 on the warm hearth palette.

configs.name: pixelart-270-snap
configs.notes: The pixel-art preview's 270 preset with the camera snap (snapCamera): its effect on shimmer.

configs.name: pixelart-360
configs.notes: The pixel-art preview's 360 preset: 360 rows, four sun bands, no edges, a lighter dither.

configs.name: shadows-low
configs.notes: The Shadows setting on Low (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §10, shared/look/shadows.json); the baseline draws High, the desktop default.

configs.name: shadows-off
configs.notes: The Shadows setting Off: no shadow maps.

configs.name: torch-shadows-off
configs.notes: Torch shadows Off (docs/LIGHTS.md §4, shared/look/lights.json `shadows`; `?torchshadows=off`): held torches light unshadowed, placed ones by the flood light alone.

configs.name: torch-shadows-high
configs.notes: Torch shadows on High (the desktop default is Low).

configs.name: lod-shadows-off
configs.notes: The distant terrain's shadows off (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §12, shared/look/lodshadows.json; `?lodshadows=off`), the cascades on High: the third layer's cost.

configs.name: raster-half
configs.notes: The mesher at half resolution, stretched by the browser (?scale=).

configs.name: loading-off
configs.notes: The game without its loading screen on joining (?loading=off, ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3): the join's timeline as before the screen.
